description: An interactive list of roles with expandable permission matrices. Each role header can be expanded to reveal a grid of checkboxes for toggling individual permissions.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between role headers, permission checkboxes, and action buttons
Expands or collapses the focused role header; activates buttons
Toggles the focused permission checkbox; expands/collapses role headers

focus.notes: Focus follows a logical order through role headers, then into permission checkboxes when a role is expanded. Focus ring is visible on all interactive elements.

announcements: Role name, description, and permission count are announced for each role header
Built-in badge is announced when present
Each permission checkbox announces its label and checked state

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for role names, labels, and descriptions)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for borders, checkboxes, and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: Provide meaningful permission descriptions to aid screen reader users
Ensure onRolesChange feedback is communicated to assistive technology
When adding custom roles, ensure unique and descriptive names
